description: This Java class 'EntityManagerUtils' provides utility methods to manage JPA EntityManager instances within a Spring application context, including opening, closing, and retrieving EntityManagers, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: EntityManagerUtils
classes.description: A Spring component utility class for managing JPA EntityManager instances, facilitating session management during testing.

methods.name: openEntityManager
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves an EntityManager, binding it to the current transaction context if not already bound.

methods.name: closeEntityManager
methods.description: Unbinds and closes the EntityManager associated with the current transaction context.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the current injected EntityManager instance.
